blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Wednesday said it is investigating 26 more cases of alleged anomalous flood control projects across the country. According to the NBI, these are in addition to the 47 flood control projects that were flagged in the first district of Davao City. Of the 26 cases, five were under the Cebu District Office, one in Calabarzon Regional Office, nine in Southeastern Mindanao Regional Office, seven in Bulacan District Office, one in Bulacan South District Office, two in Fraud and Financial Crimes Division, and one in Bayombong District Office, according to the list […]...
